title: Card Forge
description: A trading card generator in the style of Pokémon cards. Feed it an image, a description and some attributes, then export the card as a PNG. Everything runs in the browser — nothing is uploaded and there is no server.
approach: A Vite + React + TypeScript app with a shadcn/ui interface. The card itself is drawn on a canvas, which keeps it independent of the surrounding theme — the UI has pure-white and pure-black modes that follow the OS by default, but exports look identical either way.
